_comment: Benchmark + pricing snapshot for the evaluation set. Pricing drives scripts/cost_calc.py (reproducible cost tables). Benchmarks are dated public figures; null = not published by the source at review time (never interpolated). Prices USD per 1M tokens. Benchmark sourcing convention (since 2026-07-28): aa_index = Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1 scale (rebased 2026-06-15, ~5 pts lower than v4.0 — never compare across scales); gpqa_diamond + hle = AA independent runs; swe_bench_verified + swe_bench_pro = BenchLM boards (independent; a model absent from the board is null even if a vendor card claims a score); arena_elo = arena.ai text/overall style-control board.

sources.benchmarks: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1 (artificialanalysis.ai/models) · Arena (arena.ai/leaderboard) · BenchLM SWE-bench Verified/Pro (benchlm.ai, boards dated 2026-07-27) · AA independent GPQA-Diamond/HLE runs — all extracted 2026-07-28
sources.pricing: Official provider pricing pages only; all 16 headline prices re-verified 2026-07-28 (12/13 pre-existing entries matched exactly; the exception was the retired Grok 4 — see the Grok 4.5 entry). Aggregator conflicts resolved in favor of the official page. Re-checked 2026-08-12 against OpenAI's pricing page after the 2026-07-30 GPT-5.6 price cut; Terra ($2/$12) and Luna ($0.20/$1.20) added as separate rows.

openrouter_model_count._comment: Single source of truth for every 'OpenRouter has N models' mention; rendered into <!--omc-->...<!--/omc--> spans by scripts/update_readme.py as ~(count rounded to the nearest 10).
openrouter_model_count.source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (live API list; OpenRouter's homepage markets '400+ Models')

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.notes: Released 2026-07-24. AA v4.1 #1 (max config) and SWE-bench Verified leader (96.0). Arena Elo still settling (~2.4K votes, +/-12). Same list price as Opus 4.8.

models.name: Claude Fable 5
models.notes: Arena #1 (1508+/-6, 16K votes — settled) and HLE leader. AA lists it in an adaptive-reasoning config with Opus 4.8 fallback. SWE-bench Pro 80.0 — the 80.3 figure previously here belongs to Claude Mythos 5 (limited availability).

models.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.notes: Released 2026-07-09; OpenAI's current flagship. Sol's own list price is unchanged (same as GPT-5.5), but on 2026-07-30 OpenAI cut the rest of the family: Terra $2.50/$15 -> $2/$12 and Luna $1/$6 -> $0.20/$1.20 — both now priced separately below. AA score is the max-effort config.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.notes: Mid tier of the GPT-5.6 family. Cut 20% on 2026-07-30 (was $2.50/$15). No independently published benchmark scores yet, so it is priced here but absent from the benchmark table.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.notes: Cheapest tier of the GPT-5.6 family, cut 80% on 2026-07-30 (was $1/$6) — a frontier-family model at budget-tier pricing, which resets the cheap end of routing maths. No independently published benchmark scores yet, so it is priced here but absent from the benchmark table.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.notes: New top open-weights model on AA v4.1 (takes the crown from GLM-5.2/K2.6); weights on HF 2026-07-27. Arena Elo still settling (~3.6K votes). Flagship-tier price for an open model.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Now docs-listed under 'Legacy models' (still Active; retirement floor 2027-05-28). Superseded by Opus 5 at the same price.

models.name: GPT-5.5
models.notes: Unified agentic/reasoning model; emits hidden thinking tokens billed as output. Long-context tier above 272K input bills $10/$45. 1M-token context via the API (the 400K figure is the Codex cap only). AA score is the xhigh config.

models.name: Grok 4.5
models.notes: Current xAI flagship (released 2026-07-08); represents the Grok line in the cost set. Price doubles above 200K context. Replaces the retired Grok 4 (grok-4-0709, retired 2026-05-15, was $3/$15).

models.name: GLM-5.2
models.notes: MIT-licensed 744B MoE (40B active), open-weighted 2026-06-16; was the open-weights AA leader until Kimi K3. Same list price as GLM-5.1, which it supersedes in the cost set.

models.name: Muse Spark 1.1
models.notes: Closed-source frontier model from Meta Superintelligence Labs (released 2026-07-10; the original Muse Spark scores 43.1 on AA v4.1). Arena #8. No official API pricing published — excluded from cost tables.

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
models.notes: Cost-tier Gemini; no long-context surcharge. Superseded in the cost set by Gemini 3.6 Flash (same input price, cheaper output). AA score is the high-reasoning config.

models.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
models.notes: GA 2026-07-21; matches 3.5 Flash intelligence at a cheaper output rate ($7.50 vs $9). Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ($0.30/$2.50) is the new floor of the family.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.notes: Price doubles above 200k context ($4/$18). Arena #10 (86K votes); still 'Preview' status in Google's docs. Absent from the BenchLM SWE boards at review time.

models.name: Qwen3.7 Max
models.notes: DashScope USD pricing RMB-derived and promo-heavy — excluded from cost tables to avoid stale FX. BenchLM flags its SWE rows lower-confidence.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.notes: MIT-licensed open weights. AA/BenchLM figures are the Max-effort variant (base = 73.6/52.1 on SWE V/Pro). AIME figure is the V3.2 baseline; V4-Pro-specific reproduction pending.

models.name: Kimi K2.6
models.notes: Coding/agentic value pick — ~80% SWE-bench Verified at a fraction of flagship price. No longer the open-weights AA leader (Kimi K3 is). Moonshot legacy V1 platform sunsets 2026-08-31.

models.name: GLM-5.1
models.notes: First Chinese model to top SWE-bench Pro (58.4, self-reported at launch; BenchLM independent = 58.4 confirmed). Superseded by GLM-5.2 at the same price.

models.name: Grok 4.3
models.notes: AA v4.1 independent figures replace the earlier Grok-4 extrapolations. Price doubles above 200K context; retired Grok 4 slugs are served by grok-4.3 and billed at these rates. Grok 4.5 represents xAI in the cost set.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Cheapest Claude; strong SWE-bench for its tier.

models.name: Mistral Large 3
models.notes: European open-weights MoE; value pick. 'Large 3' = $0.50/$1.50 (legacy Large was $2/$6). Official page states cached input is '-90%' without publishing a per-MTok figure.

models.name: GPT-5.4 nano
models.notes: Cheapest OpenAI reasoning tier; cost-table representative. Official cached price $0.02 (aggregators claiming $0.005 are wrong).

models.name: DeepSeek V4-Flash
models.notes: Cost floor across every scenario. Cache reads ~98% off. Legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner aliases were discontinued 2026-07-24.
